topic: Kakashi's strongest form in chapter 689 was Obito's spirit working through him and vanished when the spirit left
title: Kakashi's Strongest Form Lasted One Battle
description: In chapter 689 Kakashi gets dual Mangekyo, Susanoo and intangible strikes from Obito's spirit, then loses all of it. Is borrowed power really strength? Chapters 674, 689 and the wiki explain.
comment: Was dual-Mangekyo Kakashi his real peak, or just Obito's power on loan? Pick one.

lines.text: Kakashi's strongest form lasted exactly one battle.

shot.fallback: armoured spirit forming around a silver haired ninja

lines.text: It happens in chapter 689, and it isn't really his.

shot.fallback: ghost of a boy standing behind a ninja

lines.text: Kakashi loses his Sharingan back in chapter 674.

shot.fallback: ninja with a closed scarred left eye

lines.text: Then Obito's spirit settles inside him, carrying both Mangekyo.

shot.search: Obito spirit inside Kakashi both Mangekyo
shot.fallback: ghost merging into a silver haired ninja

lines.text: Those eyes hold Six Paths chakra, so Kakashi feels no strain at all.

shot.fallback: ninja glowing with golden chakra and spiral eyes

lines.text: He phases his whole body through Kamui, then pairs it with his Lightning Cutter.

shot.fallback: ninja with a lightning hand phasing through attacks

lines.text: Then comes Susanoo, honed into a Complete Body.

shot.fallback: giant armoured spirit around a ninja

lines.text: Compare that with his own Mangekyo, which cost him for over a decade.

shot.fallback: tired ninja with a failing red eye

lines.text: The moment Obito's spirit returns to the afterlife, every one of those abilities is gone.

shot.fallback: ghost fading into light beside a ninja

lines.text: Some say that proves Kakashi is nothing without Obito.

shot.fallback: scarred man looking at an old friend

lines.text: I read it the other way. Power you can't keep isn't a skill, it's a loan.
Kakashi's real strength was the slow version nobody could lend him.

shot.fallback: silver haired ninja training with a red eye

lines.text: Hold onto that loan, because the eye he did keep is the one Madara decided to steal.

shot.fallback: old warlord holding a glowing red eye

lines.text: Because the strongest form Kakashi ever had was the one he never owned, so...
